 1 | Befriend | 1 horse | 1 min/lvl | 50' | U

15 | Mass Riding | 1 target/lvl | 1 hr/lvl | 100' | U
16 | Charging III | caster | - | self | U
17 | Mass Hide Tracks | 1 horse/lvl | 1 hr/lvl | 500' | U
18 | Mass Stamina | 1 horse/lvl | 1 hr/lvl | 500' | U
19 | Mass Horse Calling | 1 horse/lvl | - | 10 mi/lvl | U
20 | Riding True | caster | 1 hr/lvl | self | U
25 | Charging True | caster | - | self | U
30 | Mass Charging True | 1 target/lvl | - | 500' | U
50 | Ghost Force | 1 target/lvl | - | 500' | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any Animal Mastery maneuvers that
deal with horses.
@@ 2
Caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any Animal Healing maneuvers
performed on horses.
@@ 3
Caster receives a special bonus of +10 to all Riding maneuvers for the
duration.
@@ 4
Caster receives a special bonus of +15 to all attempts to track someone who is
riding a horse.
@@ 5
Adds +20 to the caster’s Mounted Attack combat maneuvers for the current
round.
@@ 6
Caster’s horse can travel at double its normal rate and spend exhaustion
points as if it were walking. When the horse stops traveling, this spell is
canceled.
@@ 7
Caster can ride at a normal pace without leaving tracks or other visible signs
of his passing. This can normally be resolved as a special penalty of -60 to
the Tracking maneuvers of those who attempt to track the caster using mainly
visual signs.
@@ 8
As Riding I, except the bonus is +20.
@@ 9
Caster can ride silently, so long as he does not create a sound originating
more then 10 feet from his body.
@@ 10
As Charging I, except the bonus is +30; in addition, the charge attack
delivers an Unbalancing critical two levels lower in severity to any normal
critical delivered (i.e., a ''C'' critical would inflict an additional ''A''
Unbalancing critical, a ''B'' critical would inflict an ''A'' Unbalancing
critical with a special modification of -25, an ''A'' critical would inflict
an ''A'' Unbalancing critical with a special modification of -50). The attack
must occur in the round this spell is cast.
@@ 11
Caster can ''call'' any one known specific horse that the caster has ridden
before. If it is physically possible, the animal will come to him if the horse
is within range when this spell is cast.
@@ 12
As Charging I, except affects up to one target per level.
@@ 13
As Riding I, except the bonus is +30.
@@ 14
Caster’s horse can travel at triple its normal rate and not spend any
exhaustion points. When the horse stops traveling, this spell is canceled.
@@ 15
As Riding II, except up to one target per level is affected.
@@ 16
As Charging I, except the bonus is +40; in addition, caster delivers an
Unbalancing critical one level less in severity to any normal critical
delivered (i.e., a ''B'' critical would inflict an additional ''A''
Unbalancing critical, an ''A'' critical would inflict an ''A'' Unbalancing
critical with a special modification of -25).
@@ 17
As Hide Tracks, except it affects one horse per level.
@@ 18
As Stamina, except it affects one horse per level.
@@ 19
As Horse Calling, except it calls up to one horse per level (up to as many are
as are able to come).
@@ 20
As Riding I, except the bonus is +40.
@@ 25
As Charging I, except the bonus is +50; in addition, caster delivers an
Unbalancing critical of equal severity to any normal critical delivered.
@@ 30
As Charging II, except affects up to one target per level.
@@ 50
As Hide Tracks and Silent Ride, except it affects one horse and rider per
level of the caster and each horse is allowed to ride at double normal
movement rate and not break the effects of the spell.
